subject: general
question: Find the simplified value of 7⁻⁸ × 11⁻⁸ × 13⁻⁸.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When multiplying expressions with the same exponent, directly multiply their bases.

⇒ 7−⁸ × 11−⁸ × 13−⁸ = (7 × 11 × 13)−⁸

⇒ (1001)−⁸ = 1 / 1001⁸

**∴ The correct answer is 1 / 1001⁸.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression: 7−⁸ × 11−⁸ × 13−⁸

**Formula Used:**

am × bm × cm = (a × b × c)m

a−m = 1 / am

**Calculation:**

⇒ 7−⁸ × 11−⁸ × 13−⁸

⇒ (7 × 11 × 13)−⁸

⇒ (77 × 13)−⁸

⇒ 1001−⁸

⇒ 1 / 1001⁸

**∴ The correct answer is 1 / 1001⁸.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Product of Powers Rule

When multiplying terms with the same base, add their exponents: am × aⁿ = am⁺ⁿ.

Power of a Power Rule

When raising an exponent to another power, multiply the exponents: (am)ⁿ = am×ⁿ.

Negative Exponent Rule

A negative exponent means taking the reciprocal of the base raised to a positive power: a−m = 1 / am.
